map.算法：束功率 P = 加速电压(kV)×束流(mA)（W）；线能量 E = P/: Algorithm: beam power P = acceleration voltage (kV) times beam current (mA) (W); linear energy E = P / weld speed (J/mm); estimated penetration = material coefficient k times sqrt(E) (mm), k: steel 0.35, aluminum 0.45, copper 0.28, titanium 0.38, nickel-base 0.32; beam-spot area = pi times d^2/4 (mm2); power density = P / beam-spot area (W/mm2). Grading: E<200 J/mm low heat input, <1000 medium, else high; power density >10^4 high-super, >10^3 high, >10^2 medium, else low. Weld width approx 0.3 times penetration; melt mass by steel density 7.85 g/cm3.

map.这是电子束深熔焊（匙孔效应）的经验规律：功率密度足够高时形成蒸气匙孔，熔深主要由: This is the empirical law of EBW deep-penetration (keyhole effect): when power density is high enough a vapor keyhole forms, and penetration is mainly set by keyhole depth, which grows sub-linearly (about sqrt(E)) with heat input. This tool k is a material coefficient; actual penetration is also affected by focus position, vacuum and joint form, and should be calibrated by process tests.

map.束斑可以聚焦到 0.1~1mm 量级，几千瓦功率集中在极小面积上，功率密度轻易达: The beam can focus to 0.1 to 1 mm scale, concentrating several kW on a tiny area, easily reaching 10^4 to 10^6 W/mm2, 2 to 3 orders above arc welding, enabling large-depth-ratio deep-penetration welds. The cost is a vacuum environment, high assembly precision and expensive equipment.
